faq.q: How many guests can the Mangusta 80 hold for a stag do?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 accommodates 12 guests comfortably, perfect for a stag weekend group. With 24 metres of deck space, a flybridge, and a spacious saloon, there's room to party, sunbathe, and dine without feeling cramped.

faq.q: What's included in the €4,719 minimum charter?
faq.a: The 4-hour charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA (21%). A jet ski is also included free of charge — ideal for stag antics.

faq.q: Can we extend the charter beyond 4 hours?
faq.a: Yes. You can extend to 6 or 8 hours by prior arrangement via WhatsApp. Longer charters allow time for a lunch stop at Cala del Faro, a swim in Cabopino, and sunset drinks off Estepona. Rates are confirmed directly.

faq.q: Where does the yacht depart from for Sotogrande?
faq.a: All our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, about 20 minutes by road from Sotogrande. Pick-up can be arranged from Sotogrande marina if preferred, but standard departure is Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What's the best lunch spot on the itinerary?
faq.a: Cala del Faro is the top choice — a beachfront chiringuito with fresh seafood, paella, and cold beers. The yacht anchors offshore, and you're tendered to the beach. Reserve ahead for a large stag group.

faq.q: Is the jet ski suitable for stag groups?
faq.a: Absolutely. The free jet ski is a highlight — guests can take turns riding it under the skipper's supervision. It's great fun and adds a competitive edge to the day. Life jackets are provided.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we'll reschedule or offer a full refund. The Costa del Sol enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare, especially in summer.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and decorations?
faq.a: Yes — you're welcome to bring a cake, decorations, or extra food. Just let us know in advance. The yacht has a fridge, ice box, and plenty of storage. No glass bottles on board, please.

data.body_html:
Planning a Sotogrande stag weekend in 2047? Ditch the crowded clubs and take the whole group out on a private yacht charter from Puerto Banús. With 12 guests, a 24-metre Mangusta 80, and a free jet ski thrown in, this is the ultimate lads' day on the Costa del Sol. Below is a full 8-hour itinerary, pricing, and everything you need to book.

Why a Yacht for a Sotogrande Stag Weekend?

A stag do on the water means total privacy, unlimited drinks, and zero queues. You control the music, the stops, and the pace. The Mangusta 80 fits exactly 12 people — your whole crew — and departs from Puerto Banús, just 20 minutes from Sotogrande. No strangers, no noise limits, just your group and the Mediterranean.

The Yacht: Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax)

This Italian-built beast has a flybridge for sunbathing, a spacious saloon with a bar, and a massive bow sunpad. Top speed around 30 knots. The free jet ski is stored on the swim platform, ready for action. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and 21% IVA.

Sample 8-Hour Itinerary for 12 Lads

  • 11:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús. Board the Mangusta 80, safety briefing, ice chest loaded with beers and cava.
  • 11:30 – Depart east towards Cabopino. First swim stop in Cala del Faro — crystal-clear water, jet ski session.
  • 13:00 – Anchor off Cala del Faro beach. Lunch at the chiringuito (fresh grilled fish, paella, cold beers). Reserve ahead.
  • 15:00 – Cruise west past Marbella's Golden Mile, La Concha backdrop. Music on, drinks flowing.
  • 16:30 – Second swim stop off Estepona coast. Jet ski relay race.
  • 18:00 – Sunset anchor near Puerto Banús. Cava toast, group photos.
  • 19:00 – Return to Puerto Banús. Head to Ocean Club or Pangea for the evening.

Pricing: What It Costs for a Stag Group

ItemCost
Mangusta 80 minimum 4h charter€4,719
Additional hours (negotiable)On request
Jet ski (included free)€0
Lunch at Cala del Faro (approx per person)€30–€50
Decorations / cake / extra foodBYO or arrange via WhatsApp

For 12 guests, the per-person cost for the boat alone is under €400 for 4 hours — cheaper than a club table and far more memorable.

How to Book Your 2047 Stag Weekend

All bookings are handled via WhatsApp. Send us your preferred date, group size, and any special requests (decorations, specific lunch spot, extra hours). We'll confirm availability and send payment details. A 50% deposit secures the date. The remaining balance is due 7 days before departure.

For more options, check our full fleet at Boat Rental Marbella.

What to Bring on a Stag Yacht Charter

  • Swimwear, towels, sunscreen (SPF 50+)
  • Sunglasses and a hat
  • Your own playlist (Bluetooth speaker on board)
  • Extra beer or spirits (no glass bottles)
  • Decorations – stag sashes, inflatables, banner
  • Cash for lunch and tips

Why Sotogrande for a Stag Weekend?

Sotogrande is a luxury enclave with world-class golf, polo, and nightlife. But the real draw is the coast — quiet coves, exclusive beach clubs, and easy access to Puerto Banús. A yacht charter ties it all together: you get the freedom of the sea with the buzz of the marina. For a 2047 stag do, it's the smart play.

Frequently asked questions

How many guests can the Mangusta 80 hold for a stag do?

The Mangusta 80 accommodates 12 guests comfortably, perfect for a stag weekend group. With 24 metres of deck space, a flybridge, and a spacious saloon, there's room to party, sunbathe, and dine without feeling cramped.

What's included in the €4,719 minimum charter?

The 4-hour charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA (21%). A jet ski is also included free of charge — ideal for stag antics.

Can we extend the charter beyond 4 hours?

Yes. You can extend to 6 or 8 hours by prior arrangement via WhatsApp. Longer charters allow time for a lunch stop at Cala del Faro, a swim in Cabopino, and sunset drinks off Estepona. Rates are confirmed directly.

Where does the yacht depart from for Sotogrande?

All our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, about 20 minutes by road from Sotogrande. Pick-up can be arranged from Sotogrande marina if preferred, but standard departure is Puerto Banús.

What's the best lunch spot on the itinerary?

Cala del Faro is the top choice — a beachfront chiringuito with fresh seafood, paella, and cold beers. The yacht anchors offshore, and you're tendered to the beach. Reserve ahead for a large stag group.

Is the jet ski suitable for stag groups?

Absolutely. The free jet ski is a highlight — guests can take turns riding it under the skipper's supervision. It's great fun and adds a competitive edge to the day. Life jackets are provided.

What happens if the weather is bad?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we'll reschedule or offer a full refund. The Costa del Sol enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare, especially in summer.

Can we bring our own food and decorations?

Yes — you're welcome to bring a cake, decorations, or extra food. Just let us know in advance. The yacht has a fridge, ice box, and plenty of storage. No glass bottles on board, please.
